title: The Bolsheviks kill the Romanov family
summary: Former Tsar Nicholas II, his wife, their five children and four servants were shot by Bolshevik guards in the Ipatiev House in Yekaterinburg.
reason: With White forces approaching the city, the Bolsheviks feared the family could be rescued and become a rallying point.
significance: It ended the Romanov dynasty and signaled the ruthlessness of the Civil War.
